reviewer: Codex direct visual inspection on 2026-10-08 of all 30 correspondence_review.png six-panel figures in mercury-heldout-four-modality-v2-20261008. Technical, coarse correspondence only. Display composites are independently stretched; their colors are not calibrated mineral classifications. Review notes are excluded from model inputs.

reviews.observation: Tyagaraya: central rim, interior bright patches and surrounding craters correspond between optical and MDR views; DEM depression occupies the same target footprint.
reviews.limitations: MDR is visibly coarser; optical context seams remain. Fine registration and radiometric equivalence are unverified.

reviews.observation: Picasso: asymmetric bright rim and interior pattern correspond in both image products; neighboring crater arrangement agrees at context scale.
reviews.limitations: Strong illumination and display contrast differences; DEM resolves broad relief only. No subpixel registration assessment.

reviews.observation: Asvaghosa: central circular feature and diagonal bright pattern correspond in optical and MDR panels, with a coincident broad DEM depression.
reviews.limitations: Bright-region display clipping and optical mosaic seams limit detailed comparison.

reviews.observation: Mistral: the bright patch southeast of the marker and northwest neighboring crater correspond across the image panels.
reviews.limitations: Target boundary is less distinct than neighboring bright features; coarse identity check does not certify rim segmentation.

reviews.observation: Sinan: surrounding crater arrangement and broad central depression correspond; MDR provides the same geographic footprint as the optical mosaic.
reviews.limitations: Severe rectangular optical mosaic seams cross the target and context. Retained with flags; brightness discontinuities are not geological evidence.

reviews.observation: Unkei: central rim, southern small crater and northern crater group correspond between optical and MDR panels.
reviews.limitations: MDR smoothing and illumination differences limit small-feature comparison; DEM is coarse.

reviews.observation: Titian: broad central outline, bright western region and dark northern context agree spatially across image products.
reviews.limitations: Interior and rim details are blurred in MDR; independently stretched brightness cannot be interpreted as absolute agreement.

reviews.observation: Ravel: diagonal bright bands, central feature and surrounding craters correspond across optical and MDR views.
reviews.limitations: Strong regional brightness bands and coarse MDR resolution obscure parts of the rim; no fine-registration claim.

reviews.observation: Rajnis: ring, western overlapping small crater and eastern shadowed rim correspond; DEM depression is centered consistently.
reviews.limitations: Illumination produces strong contrast differences. Small structures remain below reliable MDR interpretation scale.

reviews.observation: Takanobu: main rim, interior bright feature and northern neighboring terrain correspond at coarse scale.
reviews.limitations: MDR smooths small details; DEM and reflectance contrasts are different quantities.

reviews.observation: Moody: rim and bright central feature correspond between products; regional crater arrangement supports the same footprint.
reviews.limitations: Prominent optical mosaic seams and coarse MDR pixels affect detailed comparison; display colors are not compositional labels.

reviews.observation: Carducci: central small circular feature and surrounding main rim correspond across imagery and broad DEM relief.
reviews.limitations: MDR brightness and shadows differ from optical rendering; no independent sensor or subpixel confirmation.

reviews.observation: Whitman: target rim, interior feature and southern neighboring depression appear at corresponding positions.
reviews.limitations: MDR has stronger shadow contrast and visibly reduced spatial detail.

reviews.observation: Mussorgskiy: main crater and northern/southern neighboring craters correspond. A narrow missing-data wedge is visible west of the target in MDR local and context views.
reviews.limitations: Missing wedge is retained as nodata and excluded from valid spectral statistics; coverage passes the fixed threshold. No interpolation repair or geological interpretation of the wedge.

reviews.observation: Hitomaro: bright rim and dark areas immediately north and south correspond between optical and MDR products.
reviews.limitations: Optical seams, display contrast and MDR smoothing constrain detailed comparisons.

reviews.observation: Lessing: central bright structure, rim and interior small craters correspond in optical and MDR panels.
reviews.limitations: Broad DEM depression lacks the imagery detail; color stretch is for review only.

reviews.observation: Judah Ha-Levi: rim and southwestern small crater correspond, with consistent regional context and broad DEM depression.
reviews.limitations: Illumination differences are substantial; small-feature and subpixel correspondence are unverified.

reviews.observation: Lysippus: faint central boundary and distinctive northern neighbors correspond across image panels; DEM shows broad central relief.
reviews.limitations: Low-contrast target boundary, optical seams and regional bright material prevent a precise rim-quality claim.

reviews.observation: Mark Twain: small circle at the marker and surrounding broad ring are spatially consistent between optical and MDR panels.
reviews.limitations: Broad target rim is irregular and partially indistinct; alignment check does not resolve geological boundaries.

reviews.observation: Al-Jahiz: broad central dark region, eastern bright patches and nearby craters correspond across image products.
reviews.limitations: Prominent optical diagonal seams cross the target vicinity. MDR contrast cannot establish whether optical brightness changes are geological.

reviews.observation: Byron: diffuse central outline and strong southern bright regional feature occupy matching positions in optical and MDR views.
reviews.limitations: Optical seam passes near the marker; strong brightness streaks and weak rim definition limit local morphology analysis.

reviews.observation: Machaut: main ring and small central circular feature correspond in both image products and broad DEM relief.
reviews.limitations: MDR and DEM smooth fine morphology; display colors require separate physical interpretation.

reviews.observation: Bronte: main crater east of the catalogue marker and distinct southern crater correspond across optical, MDR and DEM views.
reviews.limitations: Catalogue marker lies west of the apparent main-crater center. Coordinate-centered masks and profiles remain unchanged and may mix rim/interior regions; no recentering or boundary correction.

reviews.observation: Zeami: main ring, patchy bright interior and surrounding crater arrangement correspond between optical and MDR panels.
reviews.limitations: Bright display clipping, shadows and MDR smoothing limit small-feature interpretation.

reviews.observation: Yeats: central bright feature and northern small crater correspond to MDR and broad DEM positions despite optical patchwork.
reviews.limitations: Severe triangular optical mosaic seams cross the target. Retained for limited evidence reasoning, with no claim of seam-free morphology.

reviews.observation: Brunelleschi: broad ring, bright southwestern interior and small eastern interior circle correspond across image products.
reviews.limitations: Patchy bright material and faint boundary limit rim delineation; MDR smooths details.

reviews.observation: Kuiper: compact bright target and regional ray-like brightness pattern correspond; DEM depression occupies the same footprint.
reviews.limitations: Optical display is extensively white-clipped and MDR is coarse. Display clipping is not established detector saturation; fine morphology and mineral identification remain unsupported.

reviews.observation: Velazquez: main ring, central feature and western small crater agree spatially across optical and MDR views.
reviews.limitations: Fine structures are smoothed in MDR and DEM; coarse review does not establish measured registration accuracy.

reviews.observation: Proust: large target outline, dark interior and surrounding bright craters correspond at local and context scales.
reviews.limitations: Target contrast is subtle amid surrounding bright material; spectral display differences are not direct compositional measurements.

reviews.observation: Calvino: bright ring, dark floor and central feature correspond across image products; DEM shows a co-located depression.
reviews.limitations: MDR coarse sampling and stretched composite colors limit detailed interpretation; no subpixel or expert approval.
